[[File:Cave goblin miner chathead.png|left|70px]]
'''Cave goblin miners''' can be found in the [[Dorgesh-Kaan mine]] under [[Lumbridge]] after completing the members-only quest [[Lost Tribe]]. Once attacked, a [[cave goblin guard]] will attack the players. These miners will mine the various [[iron rock|iron]] and [[silver rock]]s around the Dorgeshuun mines.

These cave goblin miners are under the instruction of [[Mistag]] and mine the iron in order to use it to build and repair [[Dorgesh-Kaan]]. The [[goblin]]s will also explain that they always build with bones as they have no access to trees. They also believe that [[giant frog]]s (from which they get their bones for building) are fearsome to them.

These are the only monsters which drop [[mining helmet]], one of the best light sources in the game.

==Trivia==
* There are four different variants of miners, with each having their own variant whilst idling or mining. Interestingly, one of the mining variant's chathead still uses the original cave goblin model, rather than the newer model all other cave goblins have used since early [[2007]].
* They seem to use a pickaxe which looks like a cross-over between a [[bone spear]] and a [[scythe]], though this "bone pickaxe" does not exist in ''RuneScape''.
